description: This file defines and exports a configuration function for Vitest testing framework specific to the 'agents' directory in a TypeScript project. It imports a scoped Vitest config creator and sets up a test configuration targeting agent-related test files.

methods.name: export function createAgentsVitestConfig(env?: Record<string, string | undefined>) { createAgentsVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vitest configuration object scoped to test files within the 'agents' directory, with provided environment variables.
